scope: F0 infrastructure + F1 validation. Create block10 (10-fold, seed 20261010) fold scheme per AGENTS.md. Validate champion A OOF on block10 as proof-of-concept. Prepare pipeline for finalist B when selected. No public-LB consultation.

H96_BLOCK10_INFRASTRUCTURE.question: Does the champion A OOF AUC replicate on the independent block10 (10-fold, seed 20261010) scheme? What is the OOF AUC and variance across 10 folds?
H96_BLOCK10_INFRASTRUCTURE.method: Generate block10 folds (StratifiedKFold 10, seed 20261010) per AGENTS.md. Run champion LGBM (prod5_lgbm_full_primary recipe) 10-fold CV on the 285-feature rich view. Report per-fold AUC, mean, std, and correlation with primary 5-fold OOF. Also compute the equal-logit blend of block10 OOF with primary OOF to check consistency.
H96_BLOCK10_INFRASTRUCTURE.leakage: Fold-safe: block10 folds are independent of primary folds. Training on 9/10 folds, eval on 1/10. No label leakage.
H96_BLOCK10_INFRASTRUCTURE.decision_rule: Descriptive. If champion AUC on block10 is within 2e-4 of primary 5-fold, the champion is robust. Infrastructure ready for finalist B validation.

non_goals: No new model training beyond the validation LGBM.
